aToB.memory: Although Noelle isn't in Prof. Marlowe's Potions Class this term, she occasionally crosses paths with the glamorous Dimensional Theory scholar near the Grand Athenaeum archives. Noelle once murmured half-asleep that a star-drift reading felt bent around Waystone Quad, earning a remarkably sharp, attentive look from Marlowe that stayed with her.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Noelle wants to offer Prof. Marlowe a polite greeting if they meet near the archives and quietly get to know her Dimensional Theory perspective on Skyglass Observatory drift.

bToA.memory: Evelyn barely teaches Noelle directly, yet she keeps an attentive eye on Mooncrest's resident astral diviner from afar. A girl who spends every clear night under Skyglass Observatory tracking probability ripples might notice faint anomalies around the Arrival Portal arch before most faculty ever check an instrument.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Evelyn wants to strike up a charming, seemingly casual chat with Noelle to get to know her astral methodology better—and subtly gauge whether Skyglass Observatory logged any ripples around Leo's arrival.
